div.div:
From sign-in to a cited answer
Manisha | 2026-10-15 | Actual cloud request and worker lifecycle · us-east-2

div.div:
1 · Sign in
Amplify Auth uses Cognito SRP.
Access token is held by the client.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 209, 229), rgb(57, 53, 70));

div.div:
2 · Authorize
HTTP API validates JWT issuer,
audience and required scope.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 209, 229), rgb(57, 53, 70));

div.div:
3 · Submit
POST /runs validates ≤ 2,000 chars
and 3–8 steps. Persist QUEUED META.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 209, 229), rgb(57, 53, 70));

display: inline-block; font-size: 23px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#252134, #d1cdde); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4 · Enqueue
Send run_id to SQS.
Return 202 + run_id immediately.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 209, 229), rgb(57, 53, 70));

display: inline-block; font-size: 23px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#252134, #d1cdde); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
5 · Claim
Worker conditionally claims
QUEUED → RUNNING. Skip duplicates.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 209, 229), rgb(57, 53, 70));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 444px; height: 1px; padding-top: 780px; margin-left: 1243px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 23px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#252134, #d1cdde); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
6 · Decide / validate / act
Bedrock Converse → validate →
safe tool → ordered STEP. Repeat.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 209, 229), rgb(57, 53, 70));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 444px; height: 1px; padding-top: 780px; margin-left: 673px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 23px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#252134, #d1cdde); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
7 · Finish
Validate citation IDs. Persist final
status, reason and actual usage.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 209, 229), rgb(57, 53, 70));

display: inline-block; font-size: 23px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#252134, #d1cdde); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
8 · Poll / display
GET metadata + steps every 2s.
Owner check on each read; stop at terminal.

div.div: After HTTP 202, the browser polls concurrently with worker steps 5–7; it does not wait for completion to begin polling.

div.div:
Terminal states
SUCCEEDED / FINAL_ANSWER
LIMIT_REACHED / STEP_LIMIT
FAILED / UNSUPPORTED, MODEL_ERROR, TOOL_ERROR, TIMEOUT, INVALID_TOOL

div.div:
Operational bounds
Worker: 180s; controller: ≤150s; maxTokens: 1,000 per model request.
Native tool batches execute sequentially, one step each.
Enqueue failure: 503 + saved failure. Infrastructure retries: DLQ after five receives.
A worker crash after claim can strand RUNNING; automatic recovery is deferred.
